caveat: Produced by running pretrained YOLO11 + ByteTrack over CARR's own video clips -- the same detect-and-track path that would run on Madhar Sha's cameras. Speeds are a fraction of the frame per second, not metres per second: without camera calibration there is no scale, and clips are isolated shelf interactions rather than continuous store footage. Note also that the tracker follows every person in a clip while the label describes only the primary subject, so each class carries some background traffic -- the effect below is measured despite that contamination, not in its absence.
